hero.title: Sri Satya Sai University of Technology and Medical Sciences
hero.summary: SSSUTMS teaches agriculture through a dedicated school at Sehore, with a four-year bachelor’s programme and published semester schemes. The school dates its start to July 2015, while the university’s curriculum index identifies a revised first-semester agriculture scheme from the 2025–26 session.

overview.heading: A Sehore agriculture school with a published curriculum trail
paragraphs: The university prospectus dates the School of Agriculture’s start to July 2015. It describes undergraduate agriculture teaching, and the university’s scheme page makes the degree’s semester documents available. The first-semester listing explicitly refers to the Sixth Deans’ Committee from 2025–26, while earlier schemes remain alongside it.

Published curriculum documents give applicants a way to examine the agriculture course beyond its title. The scheme index carries both revised and earlier semester documents, so the version applicable to a student’s entry year matters when comparing subjects. The university also operates a training and placement cell whose stated activities include aptitude and interview preparation, and a scholarship section that describes assistance with government applications.

admissions.heading: Applying to SSSUTMS
admissions.intro: The official notice index lists entrance and enrolment notices for 2026–27. Its agriculture eligibility table is undated, so applicants should obtain the session-specific notice and confirm the required science or agriculture subjects before registration.
eligibility_points: The official eligibility table states 45% in 10+2 PCM/PCB/Agriculture, but does not identify the admission session.

steps.text: The procedure refers to regulator-approved fees; request the dated B.Sc. Agriculture schedule and its additional charges.

campus.intro: The university disclosure index identifies common facilities and student services. A verifiable current inventory of agriculture farms and laboratories was not available in the pages read.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: The university describes assistance with government scholarships for eligible reserved-category and minority students. The page does not establish a current agriculture-specific award amount.

schemes.name: Government scholarship application assistance
schemes.details: The university states that its scholarship department helps students apply to applicable government schemes; eligibility remains governed by the scheme authority.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: SSSUTMS describes university-wide aptitude, communication and interview preparation, and explicitly includes agriculture in pre-placement training. No dated agriculture-only placement result was established.

recognition.text: The audited ICAR register identifies School of Agriculture with validity from 2025-01-27 to 2030-12-26. The programme labels below preserve the register’s scope; other institutional degrees are not covered by inference.

faqs.question: Where is SSSUTMS agriculture based?
faqs.answer: The university address is on Bhopal-Indore Road at Sehore, opposite the Oilfed plant.

faqs.question: When did the school begin?
faqs.answer: The official prospectus excerpt dates the School of Agriculture’s start to July 2015.

faqs.question: How long is the listed degree?
faqs.answer: The official prospectus describes B.Sc. Agriculture as a four-year programme.

faqs.question: What curriculum update is visible?
faqs.answer: The university scheme index lists a first-semester scheme under the Sixth Deans’ Committee effective 2025–26.

faqs.question: What ICAR expiry date is preserved here?
faqs.answer: The supplied audit prints 26 December 2030 after a 27 January 2025 start. That unusual end date is retained exactly, not recalculated.

faqs.question: Does university placement training include agriculture?
faqs.answer: The official placement-cell page explicitly includes agriculture among the disciplines receiving pre-placement training.

faqs.question: What agriculture tuition has SSSUTMS published?
faqs.answer: The official table quotes ₹61,000 annual tuition for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture without an intake-year label. It is a sourced undated figure, not a verified current payable total.
